description: Central runtime configuration registry for the Stats application. This file names the configuration surfaces that must be supplied by committed safe defaults, ignored local overrides, environment variables, or managed secret providers instead of being hardcoded in source.

STATS_APP_ROOT.purpose: Physical runtime root for the current environment.

STATS_PATHS_CONFIG.purpose: Path to the central logical path map.

STATS_RUNTIME_CONFIG.purpose: Path to the central runtime configuration registry.

STATS_LOGGING_CONFIG.purpose: Path to the central logging configuration registry.

logging.note: The central logging registry is the source of truth for logging variable defaults and allowed values. This section keeps logging environment keys discoverable in the overall runtime registry.

LOG_REDACT_SENSITIVE_VALUES.purpose: Redact known sensitive values before writing logs.

STATS_STORAGE_PROVIDER.purpose: Storage provider selector for durable files and future cloud storage.
STATS_STORAGE_PROVIDER.default: AzureBlobStorage in cloud/container, LocalFileSystem for isolated local tests

STORAGE_ROOT.purpose: Local filesystem root for accepted intake files when LocalFileSystem storage is active.

STATS_VALIDATION_HANDOFF_DIR.purpose: Temporary M9 handoff directory for Data Validation DataValidationResult JSON files awaiting Azure SQL persistence.

DOCUMENT_REFERENCE_ROOTS.purpose: Allowed source roots for document parsing references.
DOCUMENT_REFERENCE_ROOTS.note: Resolve from configured Stats storage roots or explicit module environment overrides. Do not parse this note as a filesystem path.

DATABASE_PROVIDER.purpose: Database provider selector for persistence code. Active local/container/cloud runtime target is AzureSql.

DATABASE_SCHEMA.purpose: Default relational database schema for M9-owned Stats data tables.

AZURE_SQL_CONNECTIONSTRING.purpose: Azure SQL Database connection configuration for the cloud operational Stats store. Prefer Microsoft Entra or managed identity authentication; treat as secret when credentials are present.

DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL.purpose: Optional bootstrap administrator email for local/container setup.

ALLOW_OCR_FALLBACK.purpose: Enables OCR fallback path when Tesseract is available.
ALLOW_OCR_FALLBACK.default: false locally, true in stats-runtime container

TESSERACT_CMD.purpose: Path to the Tesseract executable for the current runtime.

TESSDATA_PREFIX.purpose: Path to Tesseract language data for the current runtime.

STATS_WEB_PORT.purpose: Stats Web container bind port for local/container runtime.

STATS_WEB_HOST_PORT.purpose: External Stats Web host port mapped by Docker Compose.

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.purpose: Allowed browser origins for module APIs.

HEALTH_TIMEOUT.purpose: Service startup health wait timeout in seconds.

DB_HOST.purpose: Reserved non-Azure database host override for diagnostics only; active runtime uses Azure SQL connection configuration.

DB_PORT.purpose: Reserved non-Azure database port override for diagnostics only; active runtime uses Azure SQL connection configuration.

FILE_VALIDATION_PORT.purpose: File Validation and Ingestion API container-local port.

STATS_DATA_PORT.purpose: Stats Data persistence API container-local port.

DEBUG.purpose: Debug behavior switch for local development only.

DATABASE_ECHO.purpose: Database SQL echo switch for diagnostics.

MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES.purpose: Maximum file size accepted for validation.

REQUIRE_KNOWN_SIGNATURE.purpose: Whether file signatures must be recognized.

SUPPORTED_MIME_TYPES.purpose: MIME types supported by document parsing.

MAX_DOCUMENT_SIZE_BYTES.purpose: Maximum document size accepted by parsing.

ALLOW_DIRECT_TEXT.purpose: Whether direct PDF text extraction is allowed.

ALLOW_DOCUMENT_REFERENCES.purpose: Whether parsing can read configured document references.

DEFAULT_CURRENCY.purpose: Default currency for extraction and validation.

MAX_TEXT_CHARS.purpose: Maximum text characters processed by extraction.

statsWebDownstream.StatsApi__BaseUrl: Browser-facing Identity API base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__FileValidationBase: Browser-facing File Validation base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__FileIngestionBaseU: Browser-facing File Ingestion base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__DocumentParsingBas: Browser-facing Document Parsing base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__TransactionExtract: Browser-facing Transaction Extraction base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Downstream__DataValidationBase: Browser-facing Data Validation base URL or same-origin proxy base.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__IdentityBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Identity Access.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__FileValidationBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for File Validation.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__FileIngestionBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for File Ingestion.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__DocumentParsingBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Document Parsing.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__TransactionExtractionBa: Server-side proxy target for Transaction Extraction.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__DataValidationBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Data Validation.
statsWebDownstream.StatsWeb__Proxy__StatsDataBaseUrl: Server-side proxy target for Stats Data persistence.

STATS_TESTDATA_DIR.purpose: Configured real-data fixture directory for module and evidence tests.
STATS_TESTDATA_DIR.privacyNote: May point to local private files; do not commit real source files.

STATS_PARSING_TESTDATA_DIR.privacyNote: May point to local private files; do not commit real source files.

STATS_EDGE_EXECUTABLE.purpose: Optional browser executable override for screenshot evidence.

STATS_ENVIRONMENT.purpose: Cloud runtime environment label such as cloud-dev, test, or prod.

AZURE_CONTAINER_APP_NAME.purpose: Azure Container Apps resource name for the Stats runtime.

AZURE_CONTAINER_APP_ENVIRONMENT.purpose: Azure Container Apps managed environment name.

AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY.purpose: Azure Container Registry hostname that stores the Stats runtime image.

AZURE_KEY_VAULT_URI.purpose: Key Vault URI used for managed secret references.

AZURE_MANAGED_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID.purpose: User-assigned managed identity client ID when a cloud runtime needs an explicit identity reference.

AZURE_SQL_SERVER.purpose: Azure SQL logical server name or host for the cloud operational Stats database.

AZURE_SQL_DATABASE.purpose: Azure SQL database name for the cloud operational Stats database.

AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME.purpose: Storage account name used when STATS_STORAGE_PROVIDER=AzureBlobStorage.

AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER_NAME.purpose: Blob container name used for durable document storage when AzureBlobStorage is enabled.

AZURE_STORAGE_BLOB_PREFIX.purpose: Blob path prefix for accepted intake files.

AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING.purpose: Temporary storage connection string if managed identity storage access is not yet implemented.

FABRIC_WORKSPACE_ID.purpose: Microsoft Fabric workspace identifier used for curated analytics data and evidence.

FABRIC_LAKEHOUSE_ID.purpose: Fabric lakehouse or warehouse identifier used for curated Stats reporting data.

POWERBI_WORKSPACE_ID.purpose: Power BI workspace identifier for Stats reports.

POWERBI_REPORT_ID.purpose: Power BI report identifier for Stats dashboard/report embedding.

POWERBI_TENANT_ID.purpose: Microsoft Entra tenant identifier used for Power BI embedding or service principal authentication.

POWERBI_CLIENT_ID.purpose: Service principal client ID for app-owned Power BI embedding when required.

POWERBI_CLIENT_SECRET.purpose: Service principal secret for Power BI embedding when certificate or managed identity auth is not yet available.

rule: If a value changes by developer machine, container, cloud environment, secret rotation, deployment target, port conflict, or test fixture location, it belongs in configuration and not as an application-code literal.
